task: Fix pi's long-running-tool UX blackout in this dotfiles repo. Two deliverables, both specified by FAILING test files you must make green WITHOUT editing them: (1) Rework .pi/agent/extensions/task.ts so it parses the `pi -p --mode json` subprocess stdout INCREMENTALLY (line-buffered, not buffer-until-close) and streams throttled onUpdate progress (first update promptly, then >=1s apart, plus a final flush if updates were suppressed). The status line shows: task "<description>", elapsed time, tool-call count, last tool label; when the child emits tool_execution_update for toolName "task" (a nested subagent), relay the child's partialResult text as a " |-> <line>" suffix. Wire the AbortSignal so abort kills the subprocess (SIGTERM) and execute() resolves promptly. Pass PI_TASK_DEPTH through the child env incremented by 1 and include "depth N" in the status line when N>0. KEEP the existing final-result behavior identical: last assistant text wins across message/message_end/message_update/turn_end/agent_end events, the stderr-fallback messages, the session-id capture, and the <task_result> wrapper. Export parseSubagentEventLine, createTaskProgress, and taskTool. (2) Create .pi/agent/extensions/tool-activity.ts: a pi extension that listens to tool_execution_start/tool_execution_end, tracks active tools, and while any tool is active updates ctx.ui.setWorkingMessage() once per second to "Working... <summaryLine>" using the tracker; when no tools are active, and on agent_settled and session_shutdown, restore pi's default with ctx.ui.setWorkingMessage() (no args) and stop the timer. Guard every UI call with ctx.hasUI. Export createToolActivity. Shared helpers go in .pi/agent/extensions/lib/tool-label.ts (exports: summarizeToolArgs, formatElapsed) - NEVER a loose top-level .ts helper, pi requires a default factory from every top-level extension file. The exact API contracts and formats are defined by the tests: .pi/agent/tests/loop-task.test.ts and .pi/agent/tests/loop-activity.test.ts. Read them first; they are the spec.
rules: Do NOT edit anything under .pi/agent/tests/ - the test files are the contract. Make them pass as written.

NEVER move, edit, restore, or delete .pi/harness.json or any .pi/harness-* file. They are loop machinery. If a reviewer complains about them in the diff, that is a reviewer problem, not yours - the judge has been told to ignore them.
bin/memledger is a pre-existing uncommitted binary rebuild that predates this task. Do NOT touch it, unstage it, restore it, or try to remove it from any diff.
No new dependencies. node/bun stdlib only.
Match existing extension style: tabs for indentation, double quotes, JSDoc header comment explaining the why.
Do not run git commit, git reset, git stash, git checkout, git update-index, or any other git ref/index mutation.
A check satisfied by a stub is a FAILED iteration: no `throw new Error("not implemented")`, no empty function bodies, no hard-coded test answers.
task.ts currently ignores its `_signal` and `_onUpdate` parameters - using them is the point of this task. Keep runSubagent's stderr-fallback and '[subagent produced no output]' paths working.
If you need a paragraph-long comment to justify why a workaround is OK, the code is wrong - fix the code.

sensors.name: judge
sensors.cmd: judge --base HEAD --spec 'Two pi extension changes in this dotfiles repo. (1) .pi/agent/extensions/task.ts streams subagent progress: incremental line-buffered parsing of the `pi -p --mode json` stdout, throttled onUpdate calls (~1/sec) carrying a status line with description, elapsed time, tool count, last tool label; nested task progress relayed via tool_execution_update partialResult as a |-> suffix; AbortSignal kills the subprocess; PI_TASK_DEPTH env incremented into the child and surfaced when >0; final-result parsing (last assistant text wins, stderr fallback, session id, <task_result> wrapper) unchanged. (2) New .pi/agent/extensions/tool-activity.ts: tracks active tools via tool_execution_start/end, updates ctx.ui.setWorkingMessage every second while any tool runs, restores the default working message (no-args call) when idle and on agent_settled/session_shutdown, guards UI calls with ctx.hasUI. Shared helpers in .pi/agent/extensions/lib/tool-label.ts. Style: tabs, no new deps, JSDoc headers. REJECT if: updates are unthrottled or missing, abort does not kill the child, the working message is never restored, helpers live in a loose top-level .ts file, or the pre-existing task.ts result parsing regressed. SCOPE NOTE: `bin/memledger` (a tracked compiled binary) was already modified in the working tree BEFORE this task began and is intentionally not part of the change - do not weigh it. `.pi/harness.json` and `.pi/harness-*` files are loop machinery, not part of the change - ignore them as well.' --model openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k3
